headline: Maya sees the native path from a conversation to a portable follow-up record
overview: The account boundary is freshly walked. Deeper capture, relationship, and PDF scenes use the product's existing narrated simulator demos and are explicitly marked described rather than freshly walked.
payoff: Maya understands what the native app is designed to do and exactly where fresh authenticated evidence stops.

scenes.title: Understand the account boundary
scenes.narrative: The actual iPhone app explains why sign-in is needed, when microphone permission appears, and how an account can be created without executing the write.

scenes.title: See the intended capture and follow-up loop
scenes.narrative: Product-supplied simulator footage demonstrates capture, relationship context, and PDF export using synthetic sample content. This scene is not claimed as a fresh authenticated run.
